Git can pair a purged report with the newly added report as a rename (R), so `--diff-filter=D` leaves that doc out and `git checkout HEAD~1 --` never restores it. WHY: The deletion stays in the report PR and lands through the direct `gh pr merge --squash` (line 2156) or the `--auto` fallback (line 2160) after the #7022 guard result is stale, which is the failure the purge-drop exists to prevent. `auto_merge_pending count=` is undercounted and `purged_docs` is cleared. The sibling `scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh:192` uses `--no-renames`. The existing test seeds a `# old\n` stub that falls below the rename-similarity threshold. All reviewers rated this MAJOR; confidence ranged from 3 to 4. - .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1906-1908, 1920-1921, 2141-2149 | severity=low | confidence=5 flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash] PROBLEM: In PR mode the purge-drop restores the deleted docs and clears `purged_docs_list`, but `INFO: purged ${purged_count} ... older than ${cutoff_date}.` was already printed before that and is never corrected. WHY: In the same run the log says "purged N", then `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_PURGE_SKIPPED reason=auto_merge_pending count=N`, and exports an empty `purged_docs`, so readers and log scrapers conclude retention ran when it did not. All reviewers rated this NIT. They disagree on the commit message: z-ai_glm-5_3-flash says it still mislabels the PR content; minimax_minimax-m3 says the amend at line 2143 already corrects it; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 says it changes from the "purged N" variant to a fixed text. - .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2330 area, 2882-2888, 3500-3506 | severity=low | confidence=4 flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3] PROBLEM: In PR mode `report_delivery` is `pr_merged`, so deep-audit runs its full LLM pass, commits the section locally, then exits at line 2887 with only a `::warning::` because `REPORT_BRANCH` is empty. api-redundancy does the same at line 3505. WHY: Every PR-mode run spends deep-audit's LLM budget (job timeout raised to 45 minutes) on a section that is thrown away, and the report never contains the deep-audit or API-redundancy sections. - agents.d/8963-log-analysis-report-pr-delivery.md:8 (new shapes at .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1871, 2149) | severity=low | confidence=4 flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash] PROBLEM: Two new shapes of the contractual prefix, `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_PURGE_SKIPPED reason=processing_report_unavailable` and `reason=auto_merge_pending count=`, have no `doc=` key and add a `count=` key. The registry bullet still lists only the `doc= reason=unprocessed`, `doc=all reason=processing_report_missing path=

` and `doc= reason=in_flight_project` shapes. WHY: Consumers that parse the registered shapes drop the new lines or read an empty `doc=`, and they miss `count=`. The new shapes are described only in prose (agents.d/analysis-findings-p1-report-pr.md, agents.d/analysis-findings-p4-purge-safety.md), not in the contractual registry. Both reviewers rated this NIT. === END CONSENSUS FINDINGS === === CONSENSUS TASK GAPS === - requirement: Plan P1 (docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md lines 155-183, 471, 509-528): "`deep-audit` and `api-redundancy` read the report from the run branch … They push their section commits to that same branch, using a plain fast-forward push"; "New `publish-report` job. It runs after the three jobs, with `if: always() && needs.analyze-commit-notify.outputs.report_branch != ''`"; it opens the PR and uploads the final report as artifact `workflow-log-analysis-report-final`; rollback is through repo variable `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_PUBLISH_MODE` (`pr` default or `push`). expected_change_site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml: the report-branch job outputs (lines 1043-1044), the "Commit and push deep audit section" step (lines 2882-2888), the "Commit and push API redundancy section" step (lines 3500-3506), and a new `publish-report` job after `api-redundancy`; plus the new scripts/workflow_log_analysis_publish_report.sh. confidence=4 flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash] EVIDENCE: No `publish-report` job, scripts/workflow_log_analysis_publish_report.sh, `workflow-log-analysis-report-final` artifact upload or `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_PUBLISH_MODE` exists (the rollback switch was replaced by `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_VIA_PR`). `commit_report` sets `delivery` on every committed run, so the outputs `committed` and `report_branch` at lines 1043-1044 are always empty and the `deliver-report` gate at line 3586 never passes. The section steps at lines 2882-2887 and 3500-3505 therefore always take the empty-`REPORT_BRANCH` path, which only logs `::warning::` and `outcome=skipped reason=no_report_branch`, so the deep-audit and API-redundancy sections are dropped on every run. The last run only added the warnings. The only deferral is the implementer's own "Known gap (deferred)" note in agents.d/analysis-findings-p1-report-pr.md; neither the plan nor the PR description defers it. === END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS === === FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 === - .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:line 2140, step "Commit and push report" (id commit_report): report_purged_paths="$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=D HEAD~1 HEAD -- 'analysis/workflow-optimization-*.md' 2>/dev/null)" | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3 PROBLEM: There is no `--no-renames`, so a purged doc can be paired with the new report as a rename (R), excluded by `--diff-filter=D`, and never restored. WHY: The deletion lands through direct merge, merge queue or auto-merge after the #7022 guard result is stale. `auto_merge_pending` is undercounted and `purged_docs` is cleared.
